source: Nomgar Clash (Moku, approved IP) Elderbark.glb, exported from the game's Unity data by Tools/rea-lab/scripts/unity_to_glb.py (see Tools/rea-lab/data/nomgar/glb/CHARACTERS.md). Copied unchanged.
clips: picked by glTF animation extras.states (Idle/Move/Attack/Damage/Die), never by name; baked at load by src/render/skinBake.ts
role: boss elderbark (W1 forest tier boss; models only, spec step 6)
note: height/footprint = rest pose (Idle frame 0) in model units, measured by the bake (bakeSkins in node, same as __mb.bossInfo()); tuning radius = sqrt(half-width x half-depth) at the full-scale tuning height (TUNING.bosses).
